description: Find Godot projects under a directory by locating project.godot files. Use when no project is named; to inspect a known one use check_project. recursive: true descends into subdirectories (skipping .git, .godot, node_modules, etc.); the default checks the directory and its immediate children. Returns: projects[], each { projectPath, name }, name being config/name else the folder name. warnings leads when a path could not be read or a link was not followed. Errors if directory is not a directory.

directory.description: Directory to search for Godot projects

name: list_projects

name.description: config/name from project.godot; the folder name when unset.
